topics.topic: The Night the Lightship Stopped Answering
topics.guidance: After Hours File. One case: South Goodwin lightship, nineteen fifty four. Empty radio watch. No gore. Do not title it like Bedtime Stories.

topics.topic: The Reservoir That Logged Visitors After Closing
topics.guidance: Wanaque Reservoir lights, nineteen sixty six. Police log vs sky. Separate claim from evidence.

topics.topic: The Pilot Who Named a Machine Then Went Quiet
topics.guidance: Frederick Valentich, Bass Strait, nineteen seventy eight. Radio transcript. Do not declare a craft. Do not clone famous clickbait titles.

topics.topic: The Hangar That Filed a Light and Nothing Else
topics.guidance: A small USAF or RAF duty log of an unidentified light with no wreckage. Named base, named year. Balanced.

topics.topic: Twenty Minutes at a Closed Halt
topics.guidance: A railway halt that recorded a stop when no train was scheduled. Fog, timetable, one witness. No crash gore.

topics.topic: The Cable Station That Answered With Silence
topics.guidance: A shore station expected a routine cable and received none; later traffic resumed. Named place. No sinking montage.

topics.topic: The Watchman Who Reported a Second Moon
topics.guidance: Night watch, industrial site, a second pale disk. Weather balloon / moon dogs as the open alternatives. Do not mock him.

topics.topic: The Folder Stamped Weather and Left Open
topics.guidance: Lights misfiled as weather in a civil aviation folder. Show the stamp. Show what the stamp does not explain.

topics.topic: The Ferry That Radioed Fog Inside Clear Air
topics.guidance: One crossing, one radio call, visibility disagreement between bridge and shore. Named ferry, named year.

topics.topic: The Archive Print With a Date That Did Not Exist
topics.guidance: A photograph in a municipal archive whose stamped date is impossible (calendar error vs swapped plate). No haunted-photo jump scare.

topics.topic: The Beacon That Lit a Hill With No Power Line
topics.guidance: A reported ground light on a hill with no recorded supply. Survey map, later explanation candidates. Balanced.

topics.topic: The Shift Report That Named a Color Nobody Else Saw
topics.guidance: Two night-shift workers; one names a color in the sky the other does not. Logbook vs memory. No abduction plot.

topics.topic: The Town That Logged One Hour Twice
topics.guidance: A municipal night log with a duplicated hour during a clock change or blackout. Paper trail, not time-travel fiction.

topics.topic: The Photograph That Arrived After the Ship
topics.guidance: A print mailed to a port office after the vessel had already left. Named port. No child victims. Close on the unclosed folder.
